newsitem.title: USA: Colombia's Comcel Q2 operating income rises.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Comcel Q2 operating income rises.

text.p: Colombian cellular phone company Comcel reported second quarter operating earnings of 7,542 million pesos, or $6.9 million, compared with 1,136 million pesos, or $1.0 million, in the year-ago second quarter.
Revenues in the second quarter were 67,398 million pesos, or $61.8 million, compared with 39,309 million pesos, or $36 million, in last year's second quarter, Comcel said.
The company said net income fell to 2,348 million pesos, or $2.2 million, in the second quarter, compared with net income of 3,302 million pesos, or $3.0 million, in the year-ago period.
Comcel's controlling shareholders are Bell Canada International Inc, Empresa de Telecomunicaciones de Santafe de Bogota and Empresa Nacional de Telecomunicaciones.
